Installation
Prerequisites
​
If you don't use the standalone script or
@pnpm/exe
to install pnpm, then you need to have Node.js (at least v22) to be installed on your system.
info
Looking for pnpm 12? It is released, but
latest
on npm is still pnpm 11, so it is installed differently. See
Installing pnpm 12
.
Using a standalone script
​
You may install pnpm even if you don't have Node.js installed, using the following scripts.
